metadata.rounding: FP16/BF16 and custom/Triton TF32 use RNE; library TF32 may use ties-away or IEEE FP32
metadata.reference: NumPy FP64 of precision-rounded inputs; total error separately uses original FP32 inputs
metadata.tf32_policy: Library validation accepts RNE, ties-away, or higher-precision IEEE FP32; custom WMMA and Triton use RNE
metadata.arithmetic_bound: atol + rtol*abs(reference) + gamma_K*(abs(A)@abs(B)); conservative FP32 u=2^-23; TF32 uses upper envelope of legal inputs
metadata.setup_timing: wall time for input placement/conversion/packing, output allocation, preparation, first dispatch and completion; includes JIT/autotuning, excludes reusable backend initialization and validation readback

timing.device: CUDA graph events or native Metal command-buffer GPU timestamps, averaged over device_batch dispatches; no host transfers or Python enqueue gaps
timing.resident: synchronized wall time with converted/packed resident inputs and reused output; includes dispatch
timing.end_to_end: wall time from original FP32 host inputs to owned FP32 host output; matrix allocations, casts, packing, placement/transfers and readback included; reusable backend context/pipelines retained
